exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean, instrumental, and spontaneous vaginal delivery)
cohort: 46,078 participants in the Stockholm Public Health Cohort with deliveries recorded in the Swedish Medical Birth Register
finding: No statistically significant difference in subsequent sexual life satisfaction was found between different modes of delivery.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in subsequent sexual life satisfaction between those who had cesarean deliveries, instrumental deliveries, or spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
